$description: Generated theme palette (scripts/lib/color.mjs). Only the brand hues come from the web product; everything else follows mobile platform rules. Like Linear's theme engine, scales are derived in OKLCH from a few inputs. 12 Radix-style steps: 1 app bg · 2 subtle bg · 3 tinted fill · 4 pressed · 5 selected · 6 subtle border · 7 border · 8 strong border · 9 key · 10 key pressed · 11 text · 12 high-contrast text; chromatic scales add solid / solidPressed (key darkened to carry white text at 4.5:1).

brand.$description: Brand hues shared with web and desktop (lody-oss/packages/ui/src/tokens/colors.stylex.ts light theme; merged from --github-merged). These are the only values taken from the web.

neutral.$description: Zero-saturation neutrals. Curve positions follow iOS light system grays: 2 grouped background, 4 cell highlight, 6 separator, 9-11 tertiary / secondary labels.
Black base like iOS dark systemBackground, so native chrome blends in; 2-4 follow the elevated backgrounds (#1C1C1E, #2C2C2E, #3A3A3C).

keyAdjust.$description: Dark mode keeps each brand hue and lifts its lightness, the way iOS system colors adapt (systemBlue #007AFF -> #0A84FF).

tint.$description: Steeper than the shared curve: from black, tints need more lightness to read.

text.$description: Step 11 reaches this contrast on step againstStep (per mode), which approximates translucent tints on the darkest surface.

categorical.$description: Label / avatar hues (OKLCH h). Lightness and chroma come from each mode so labels sit in the theme.
